biotools.summary: The ICTV to NCBITaxon SSSOM mapping is a curated cross‑reference dataset that links official ICTV virus taxa to their corresponding NCBI Taxonomy identifiers using the SSSOM (Simple Standard for Sharing Ontology Mappings) format. It provides machine‑readable, standardized mappings that enable interoperability between the ICTV taxonomy and widely used NCBI Taxonomy resources.
biotools.name: ICTV to NCBITaxon SSSOM mapping
